headline_hook: GPT-5.4 Mini Drops as Claude Dispatch Goes Always-On and Mistral Forges an Enterprise Play

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The Snowflake sandbox escape isn't just a bug report — it's proof that enterprise AI security theater is crumbling faster than companies can deploy, and the timing alongside Google and Anthropic's open-source security investments this same week reveals an industry quietly bracing for the inevitable breach.

model_literacy.relevance: GPT-5.4 mini and nano aren't just smaller models — they're distilled variants optimized for specific task profiles (coding, computer use, subagents). Understanding distillation explains why 'mini' can outperform the original on targeted benchmarks while costing a fraction.

items.title: OpenAI Ships GPT-5.4 Mini and Nano — 2x Faster, Built for Agents
items.angle: The speed-optimized GPT-5.4 family targets the exploding subagent and computer-use market where latency matters more than peak intelligence
items.key_fact: 2x faster than GPT-5 mini across coding, computer use, and multimodal tasks

items.title: Mistral Launches Forge: Train Frontier Models on Your Own Data
items.angle: Enterprise fine-tuning just became a three-way fight — Mistral bets that proprietary data grounding, not raw scale, wins the enterprise wallet
items.key_fact: Trains frontier-grade models grounded in enterprise-specific workflows, policies, and internal context

items.title: Google Rolls Personal Intelligence Across Search, Gemini, and Chrome
items.angle: Google is betting the consumer AI war will be won on personalization, not benchmark scores — embedding user context across its entire product surface
items.key_fact: Personalized AI now spans Search, Gemini app, and Chrome simultaneously

items.title: IBM Granite 4.0 1B Speech: Multilingual Voice Model Small Enough for Edge
items.angle: A 1B speech model that runs on-device opens the door for offline multilingual assistants without cloud round-trips
items.key_fact: 1B parameters — compact enough for edge deployment

items.title: Baidu's Qianfan-OCR Reasons About Document Layout, Not Just Characters

items.title: Claude Dispatch: Your Persistent AI That Runs While You Sleep
